# Host routes and their LayerFS calls

<!-- Generated by tools/guide/cli-map.mjs from src/host/routes. Do not edit by hand; rerun it. -->

Every button in the UI calls one of these host routes (through the `http` operation), and the route runs the pinned `layerfs` CLI. The per-interaction view is [cli-map.md](cli-map.md); this table is the full list, generated from `src/host/routes/`.

Storage writes marked ↻ then read the Storage view again (`home get`, `project list`, `store auths`, `store list`).

| Route | Handler | LayerFS calls | Router note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/doctor/:id` | `routes/doctor.ts` | `<family> doctor, fix steps` | the Doctor page: /api/doctor/tree, /results, /runs, /runs/:id/stop, /fixes |
| `GET /api/storage` | `storage.view` | `home get`, `project list`, `store auths`, `store list` | Stores, buckets and the moves, backups and restores this host started |
| `POST /api/storage/check` | `storage.check` | `backup list`, `home get`, `project list`, `store auths`, `store list` | lists the buckets' files again (backup.list, one call per bucket): { bucket? }, empty for all |
| `POST /api/stores` | `storage.createStore` | `store create` ↻ |  |
| `POST /api/stores/postgresql` | `storage.connectPostgresql` | `store connect`, `store get`, `store remove-auth`, `store save-auth` ↻ | a PostgreSQL database: { name, url, auth \| passwordFrom \| user + passwordValue + authName? (a new login), synchronousCommit? } |
| `GET /api/stores/:id/stats` | `projects.storeStats` | `store get` |  |
| `GET /api/stores/:id/observations` | `projects.storeObservations` | host only |  |
| `GET /api/stores/:id/projects` | `projects.storeProjects` | `branch get`, `project list`, `project stats` |  |
| `DELETE /api/stores/:id` | `storage.removeStore` | `store remove` ↻ |  |
| `POST /api/stores/:id/disconnect` | `storage.disconnectStore` | `store disconnect` ↻ |  |
| `POST /api/stores/:id/connection` | `storage.updateStore` | `store connect`, `store disconnect`, `store get`, `store save-auth`, `store update` ↻ | a PostgreSQL Store's connection, or one machine's own address: { machine?, url?, clear?, auth? \| passwordFrom? \| passwordValue?, synchronousCommit? } |
| `GET /api/stores/:id/check` | `storage.checkStore` | `store doctor`, `store get` | the connection check from a machine (store doctor --machine): ?machine=<name> |
| `POST /api/stores/:id/push` | `storage.push` | `backup list`, `store move` | the machine a PostgreSQL Store's sessions run on by default: { machine } a sqlite Store on native to a machine (store move): { machine } |
| `POST /api/stores/:id/pull` | `storage.pull` | `backup list`, `store get`, `store move` | a sqlite Store on a machine back to native (store move <s> native) |
| `POST /api/stores/:id/move` | `storage.move` | `backup list`, `store get`, `store move` | between two machines, two moves through native in one job: { machine } |
| `POST /api/stores/:id/backup` | `storage.backup` | `backup create`, `backup list` | { bucket, file? } |
| `POST /api/stores/:id/compact` | `storage.compact` | `backup list`, `store compact`, `store get` | reclaim the Store's dead bytes (store.compact), as a job |
| `POST /api/buckets` | `storage.connectBucket` | `backup connect` ↻ | { name, url \| parts, accessKey, secretKey }: the secret goes to LayerFS on stdin |
| `DELETE /api/buckets/:id` | `storage.disconnectBucket` | `backup disconnect` ↻ |  |
| `GET /api/buckets/:id/files` | `storage.listBucket` | `backup list` |  |
| `POST /api/buckets/:id/restore` | `storage.restore` | `backup list`, `backup restore` | { store (the new Store's name), file? }: installs on native |
| `GET /api/store-auths` | `storage.auths` | host only ↻ | the home's saved PostgreSQL logins (store auths): never a password |
| `POST /api/store-auths/:id/rotate` | `storage.rotateLogin` | `store doctor`, `store get`, `store save-auth` ↻ | a login's new password (store save-auth under its own name), then every Store naming it checked; a login no Store names removed |
| `DELETE /api/store-auths/:id` | `storage.removeLogin` | `store remove-auth` ↻ |  |
| `GET /api/storage-jobs/:id` | `storage.job` | host only |  |
| `POST /api/storage-jobs/:id/inspect` | `storage.inspect` | host only |  |
| `POST /api/storage-jobs/:id/retry` | `storage.retry` | `backup list`, `store get`, `store move` |  |
| `GET /api/platforms` | `machines.platforms` | `home get` | Compute's machines. Power is manual (#535 D11): start and stop are their own calls, and no read starts one |
| `GET /api/metrics` | `metrics.view` | host only | machine and Sandbox metrics: ?machines=a,b&since=<seq>, answered from the sampler's memory (no LayerFS call, layerfs-project#182 D2) |
| `GET /api/sandbox-creates` | `sandbox-creates.list` | host only |  |
| `DELETE /api/sandbox-creates/:id` | `sandbox-creates.dismiss` | host only |  |
| `GET /api/image-loads` | `image-loads.list` | host only |  |
| `DELETE /api/image-loads/:id` | `image-loads.dismiss` | host only |  |
| `GET /api/machines` | `machines.view` | `home get`, `machine get`, `machine list`, `sandbox list`, `store list` |  |
| `GET /api/machines/:id/inspect` | `machines.inspect` | `machine get` |  |
| `GET /api/machines/:id/log` | `machines.machineLog` | `machine log` | the machine's worker log (machine.log): ?before=, ?limit=, ?rid= (a request the page can cancel); refusals answer as `stale` |
| `GET /api/machines/:id/files` | `machines.machineFiles` | `machine files` | the machine's files (machine.files): its roots without ?path=; a folder page (?cursor=, ?depth=, ?limit=) or a file window (?offset=, ?length=); ?rid= as the log |
| `GET /api/machines/:id/stats` | `machines.machineStats` | none: the metrics sampler's last `machine stats` read | what the machine has and uses now, as the metrics sampler last read it (no LayerFS call); a gap answers as `stale` |
| `GET /api/machines/:id/space` | `machines.machineSpace` | `machine stats` | where its data disk goes (machine.stats --with space): kept a minute per machine, ?fresh=1 reads now; a refusal answers as `stale` |
| `GET /api/machines/:id/sandbox-images` | `machines.sandboxImages` | `machine get`, `machine images`, `sandbox list` | what a Sandbox on it can run (the New Sandbox menu, the Images section); never starts it |
| `POST /api/machines/:id/prune-images` | `machines.pruneImages` | `machine prune` | { images?: id[], unused?: boolean } -> { removed, freed, refused }: 501 while the pinned CLI has no machine.prune |
| `POST /api/machines/:id/load-image` | `machines.loadImage` | `machine load-image` | { image } -> 202 { load }: machine.load_image in the background (`image-load` events); 501 while the pinned CLI has no machine.load_image |
| `POST /api/machines/:id/start` | `machines.start` | `machine get`, `machine list`, `machine start`, `machine stats` |  |
| `POST /api/machines/:id/restart` | `machines.restart` | `machine get`, `machine list`, `machine start`, `machine stats`, `machine stop` | an outdated worker's fix: machine stop then machine start, refused InUse while Sandboxes are on it |
| `POST /api/machines/:id/stop` | `machines.stop` | `machine stop` |  |
| `POST /api/machines` | `machines.create` | `home get`, `machine create` |  |
| `DELETE /api/machines/:id` | `machines.remove` | `machine remove` |  |
| `POST /api/machines/:id/update` | `machines.update` | `machine update` |  |
| `POST /api/machines/:id/stores` | `machines.moveStore` | store move (as a Storage job: push, pull, or pull then push) | puts a sqlite Store here (push, pull, or pull then push): { store } |
| `GET /api/status` | `projects.status` | `machine get`, `store list` |  |
| `GET /api/projects` | `projects.list` | `project list` |  |
| `POST /api/projects` | `projects.create` | `project init` |  |
| `GET /api/projects/:id` | `projects.state` | `branch list`, `project get`, `sandbox list`, `store get` |  |
| `DELETE /api/projects/:id` | `projects.remove` | `project delete` |  |
| `POST /api/projects/:id/sandboxes` | `projects.createSandbox` | `machine start`, `project get`, `sandbox create`, `sandbox list`, `store get` | a new Sandbox: { name, image? (a sha256 digest until Stage 1), machine? (PostgreSQL projects only), start?, background? } |
| `POST /api/projects/:id/close-sandboxes` | `projects.closeSandboxes` | `sandbox list`, `sandbox remove` | closes every Sandbox of the project: { force? } |
| `GET /api/projects/:id/history` | `projects.history` | `branch get`, `branch list`, `commit diff`, `commit get`, `commit list` |  |
| `GET /api/projects/:id/storage` | `projects.projectStorage` | `project get`, `project stats`, `store get` | this project's own storage from its saves' counters (see project-storage.ts): ?refresh=1 |
| `GET /api/projects/:id/size` | `projects.projectSize` | `project get`, `project stats`, `store get` | the Overview card's size: packed bytes (the Store's when alone in it: ?alone=1) and main's raw bytes |
| `GET /api/projects/:id/branches` | `projects.branches` | `branch get`, `branch list` |  |
| `GET /api/projects/:id/file-query` | `projects.fileQuery` | `branch get`, `commit diff`, `file blame`, `file history`, `file read` |  |
| `GET /api/projects/:id/stats` | `projects.projectStats` | `branch get`, `project stats` |  |
| `GET /api/projects/:id/commits` | `projects.commits` | `branch get`, `commit diff`, `commit list` |  |
| `GET /api/projects/:id/branch-commits` | `projects.branchCommits` | `branch list`, `commit diff`, `commit list` | several Branches' Commits in one call: ?branch=a&branch=b |
| `GET /api/projects/:id/sandboxes` | `projects.sandboxes` | `sandbox list` | the Sandboxes (records; Workspaces on demand) |
| `GET /api/projects/:id/fs` | `projects.listDir` | `branch get`, `file list` |  |
| `GET /api/projects/:id/file` | `projects.file` | `branch get`, `file read`, `file stat` |  |
| `DELETE /api/sandboxes/:id` | `projects.closeSandbox` | `sandbox remove` | sandbox.remove(name, { force }): ?force=1; drops the Sandbox's command logs once removed |
| `GET /api/sandboxes/:id/log` | `machines.sandboxLog` | `sandbox log` | the Sandbox's daemon log (sandbox.log), as the machine's; never waits on sandbox.get |
| `GET /api/sandboxes/:id/files` | `machines.sandboxFiles` | `sandbox files` | the Sandbox's files (sandbox.files), as the machine's; never waits on sandbox.get |
| `GET /api/sandboxes/:id` | `projects.sandbox` | `sandbox get` | one Sandbox with its Workspaces (sandbox.get) |
| `GET /api/sandboxes/:id/commands` | `commands.list` | host only | the commands this host ran in the Sandbox's Workspaces, newest first, at most 50 (commands.ts) |
| `GET /api/workspaces/:id/commands` | `commands.listWorkspace` | host only | one Workspace's commands, newest first |
| `POST /api/workspaces/:id/commands` | `commands.start` | `workspace exec` | workspace.exec in the background: { command } -> the running entry; 409 CommandRunning while one runs there |
| `POST /api/workspaces/:id/cancel` | `commands.cancel` | `workspace cancel` | workspace.cancel --exec of a command started here: { id } |
| `POST /api/workspaces/:id/commit` | `router.ts (inline)` | `workspace commit` | workspace.commit: captures the overlay as a new Commit on the Workspace's Branch: { message? } |
| `POST /api/sandboxes/:id/workspaces` | `projects.mount` | `branch fork`, `sandbox get`, `workspace mount` | a Workspace in it: { branch, fork?, name? } (only side Branches are mounted, D14) |
| `GET /api/workspaces/:id/status` | `projects.lfs.workspace.status` | `workspace status` | workspace.status, the long form: changes, branch_moved, state and companions, overlay counts, pending_merge |
| `DELETE /api/workspaces/:id` | `router.ts (inline)` | `workspace unmount` | workspace.unmount: ?discard=1&force=1; without force, 409 CommandRunning while this host runs a command there. LayerFS's refusals (Dirty with detail.changes, Busy with detail.running, Unknown) pass through; once unmounted, its command log goes. |
| `POST /api/project-sources/check` | `projects.checkSource` | host only | a folder an Init may copy from, checked before a Store is made: { source } -> { source (real path) } |
| `GET /api/project-inits` | `projects.initJobs` | host only |  |
| `GET /api/project-inits/:id` | `projects.init` | host only |  |
